name: pipcast
description: Pipcast's development marketplace, for trying Pipcast straight from this repository. Install Pipcast itself from Anthropic's plugin directory or from erdembircan-plugins.

plugins.name: pipcast
plugins.description: Picture in picture for Claude Code. While you work in other apps, a small window in the corner of your Mac's screen shows a live board of your sessions, and cuts to BREAKING NEWS, the way a 1990s local TV station would, when one needs you, finishes or stops on an error. A small macOS app that comes with Pipcast runs the window, and nothing leaves your Mac.
